page.layout: One page: a blank leather or vellum cover with an oval embossed stamp in the centre and handwritten inscriptions in ink across the upper half; no printed text blocks.
page.notes: The scan shows a bound cover or endpaper of brown leather or vellum with an oval embossed ornamental stamp (a decorative armorial or medallion) at the centre. Above it are handwritten ink strokes and scribbles, which are manuscript and not printed, so they are not transcribed. Further faint marks lie below the stamp and in the lower corners, also handwriting or staining. A dark corner ornament sits at the top right. No printed words, page number, running head, catchword or signature can be read.
